boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Rochester
boards.description: Ten distinct, under-21-safe food and drink stops with published late availability in Rochester or nearby College Town.

cards.title: Shah's Halal Food
cards.subtitle: 1377 Mt Hope Ave, College Town
cards.notes: Use the College Town location for a late meal; check the day first, since its official page lists later Friday and Saturday service.
cards.short_summary: Halal platters, gyros, sandwiches, and salads near River Campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Shah's official Rochester page lists 1377 Mt Hope Ave and hours until 11 pm Sunday–Thursday and 2 am Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed hours: Sun–Thu 10 am–11 pm; Fri–Sat 10 am–2 am. Confirm before leaving.

cards.title: Mocha House NY
cards.subtitle: 1381 Mt Hope Ave, College Town
cards.notes: Plan a coffee-and-pastry stop in College Town when you want a nonalcoholic option that remains available into the evening.
cards.short_summary: Yemeni coffee, tea, pastries, smoothies, and other drinks.
cards.evidence_claim: Mocha House NY's ordering page lists 1381 Mt Hope Ave and business hours until 11:59 pm Friday–Sunday.
cards.source_title: Mocha House NY — Online Ordering and Hours
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 8 am–11 pm Mon–Thu; 8 am–11:59 pm Fri–Sun. Confirm holiday hours directly.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies at College Town
cards.subtitle: 1333 Mt Hope Ave, College Town
cards.notes: Use this dedicated cookie stop for a simple takeout option; verify the exact closing time for the day through the location before heading over.
cards.short_summary: Cookies and milk in the College Town retail district.
cards.evidence_claim: College Town's directory identifies Insomnia Cookies at 1333 Mt Hope Ave and lists service until 1 am Sunday–Wednesday.
cards.access_notes: Directory lists late service, including until 1 am Sunday–Wednesday; confirm the current daily schedule with the shop.

cards.title: Juice Time
cards.subtitle: 1385 Mt Hope Ave, College Town
cards.notes: Choose this College Town dessert-and-drink stop when a midnight option fits better than a full meal; confirm availability on arrival.
cards.short_summary: Juices, smoothies, and dessert-oriented drinks near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: College Town's directory identifies Juice Time at 1385 Mt Hope Ave and lists it as open daily from noon until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Directory lists daily hours of 12 pm–12 am. Check directly for current hours or special closures.

cards.title: Starbucks at Wilson Commons
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Wilson Commons, River Campus
cards.notes: Stay on River Campus for drinks and light food, then check the university schedule because campus operating hours can change by academic period.
cards.short_summary: Campus Starbucks serving beverages, pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and paninis.
cards.evidence_claim: University dining identifies this Starbucks on the third floor of Wilson Commons; a University Libraries page lists Sunday hours through midnight.
cards.source_title: University of Rochester Libraries — Explore Rochester
cards.access_notes: University Libraries lists Sunday hours of 9 am–midnight; consult Rochester Dining's current hours schedule before visiting.

cards.title: The Pit
cards.subtitle: Bottom floor, Wilson Commons, River Campus
cards.notes: Use the on-campus option for dinner choices in Wilson Commons; review the university's current menu-and-hours listing before making the walk.
cards.short_summary: Campus dining with bowls, grill items, pizza, salad, and soup.
cards.evidence_claim: University dining places The Pit on the bottom floor of Wilson Commons, and a University Libraries page lists Sunday hours until 11 pm.
cards.source_title: University of Rochester Libraries — Explore Rochester
cards.access_notes: University Libraries lists Sunday hours of 11 am–11 pm. Check Rochester Dining for the applicable academic-period schedule.

cards.title: Rocky's Sub Shop
cards.subtitle: Bottom floor, Wilson Commons, River Campus
cards.notes: Build a sub or wrap in Wilson Commons, and use the dining site to confirm service during breaks, finals, and other schedule changes.
cards.short_summary: Campus sub and wrap counter on the lower level of Wilson Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: University dining places Rocky's Sub Shop on the bottom floor of Wilson Commons, and a University Libraries page lists Sunday hours until 11 pm.
cards.source_title: University of Rochester Libraries — Explore Rochester
cards.access_notes: University Libraries lists Sunday hours of 11 am–11 pm. Confirm the current academic-period schedule with Rochester Dining.

cards.title: Wendy's on Mt Hope Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1550 Mt Hope Ave, Rochester
cards.notes: Use the Mt Hope location for a drive-through or takeout run near the university area; check its daily page for the current closing time.
cards.short_summary: Fast-food restaurant on the Mount Hope corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official Rochester location directory lists the 1550 Mt Hope Ave restaurant and shows a 1 am closing time on one listed day.
cards.access_notes: Official directory shows the location and late-hours availability; consult its individual store page for today's restaurant and drive-through hours.

cards.title: Denny's on West Ridge Road
cards.subtitle: 2890 W Ridge Rd, Rochester
cards.notes: For a round-the-clock diner option, use the listed West Ridge Road location and verify service details directly if traveling from campus late.
cards.short_summary: All-day breakfast, lunch, dinner, dine-in, and takeout.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official location page lists its 2890 W Ridge Road Rochester restaurant as open 24 hours and offering round-the-clock breakfast.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours daily; it also asks customers to contact the location to confirm holiday hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West Ridge Road
cards.subtitle: 1436 West Ridge Rd, Rochester
cards.notes: Use the West Ridge restaurant when a late weekend food stop works for your route; check the direct location page for day-specific hours.
cards.short_summary: Fast-food restaurant with published late Friday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page for 1436 West Ridge Road lists Friday restaurant hours through 3 am.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1436 West Ridge Road, Rochester
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists Friday hours of 7 am–3 am. Verify today's dining-room, drive-through, and holiday hours before going.
